Lifecycle reconstruction: the adjacent classInit and card constructor establish the full 25-function original text run. A genuine dMgMCarloCardObj_c constructor and destructor reproduce 0x020f8ed8 and 0x020f7730; the typed array plus shared-state wrapper make mwccarm synthesize both scene destructor bodies exactly. Unreferenced C2/D2/D0 card variants are recorded below and deadstripped.

COINED NAMES: the behavioral helper names remain inferred from matched bodies because their ROM symbols were address-only. OnYoshiTryEat and OnTurnIntoEgg are the family-adjudicated legacy names; dScMgMCarlo_c and dMgMCarloCardObj_c are literal RTTI names; classInit is an explicitly disclosed profile/factory reconstruction.

D3 declarations: GXS::LoadOBJPltt, Sound::PlayBank2_2D, ApproachLinear and ApproachLinear2 use their demangled C++ spellings. The few C-linkage engine declarations retain the parameter types measured at this TU's call sites. Shared-state fields now live under mShared; the own-tail unk_60a8/unk_60aa/unk_60ae and inherited pad_4660 remain evidence-bounded unknowns.

Focused verifier limitation: 24/25 functions report MATCH. dScMgMCarlo_c_classInit has byte-identical code but objisolate cannot represent the same-object _ZTV13dScMgMCarlo_c relocation with addend zero; the production linker resolves it, and the linked ov006 plus full stock ROM are byte-identical.
